designationHistory.indexText: Hackmatack National Wildlife Refuge was established on November 6, 2012 with the donation of a 12 acre conservation easement conservation easement A conservation easement is a voluntary legal agreement between a landowner and a government agency or qualified conservation organization that restricts the type and amount of development that may take place on a property in the future.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page does not say how it was established.
